entities.summary: Gideon John Davies FMedSci, FRS is a British structural biologist and chemist known for his research on the structure, mechanism, and biological roles of carbohydrate-active enzymes. He is a professor at the University of York and holds the Royal Society Ken Murray Research Professorship. His research work focusses on understanding how enzymes synthesise, break down, modify and interact with complex carbohydrates.
